name: serial-monitor
description: Antigravity side panel, cooperative serial broker, and hub4com RFC2217 flasher for agentic ESP8266 PlatformIO development on Windows.
suggestedPrompts: Open the Serial Monitor side panel
Start watching ESP8266 serial logs on rfc2217://192.168.1.50:3030?ign_set_control
Flash the ESP8266 firmware over RFC2217 and check the 74880-baud boot log
